text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh... A race... broadcast...?
The girl running in the lead is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Stage screen hijack: successful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sight of Twin Turbo running reached
Tokai Teio as she stood on the stage
of her farewell concert.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo in the lead! Twin Turbo in the lead!
Her opponents are a lineup of powerhouse contenders. But—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Nobody can reel her in! Nobody!
Down the final stretch, what is this absurd, explosive burst of speed—!?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Go for it!!!! Turbo!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An ear-splitting roar echoes.
As if pushed forward by that cheer—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: THIS IS WHAT NEVER GIVING UP LOOKS LIIIIKE--!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teiooooo!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She pulled it off brilliantly, Twin Turbo!
Crossing the finish line now in 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
I even held off this opponent!
There is no race I cannot win!
There is nothing I cannot do!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...There's no way I can lead all the way to the finish.
So many strong Umamusume enter
the All Comers every year..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "I heard this year is packed with heavy hitters. A blatant front-runner strategy like that would just..."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "Turbo's still gonna win! I'm definitely gonna lead all the way to victory!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You... are...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Teio! It's way too early
to give up now--!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That's right, you've still got this!!
You can still do it, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Te-i-o!! Te-i-o!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Twin Turbo had achieved a truly historic and resounding victory, but...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp, wheeze, gasp*...
Did you... see that... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "Did you see that... Teio...? Heheh... hehehe..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The little bullet that burned through all its fuel
lay sprawled on the ground, unable to get up.
Yes, all that power was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Entrusted to her stride—heading toward Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way I can win... I thought there was no way I could do it...
But..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Just to tell me that "you never know until you try"... you went through all that...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if I can do that, too.
If I just don't give up, until the very, very, very end.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even if it seems impossibly miraculous...
Still, just one more time...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Truly—it was a miraculous run.
However, even if it is nearly impossible..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "With the bond between those who wish for it so fiercely and those who support them—it will surely, undoubtedly happen."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Splendid work, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Yeah, great work to you too, Ikuno Dictus.
Yeah, good work to you too, Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only an Umamusume can make a miracle happen.
However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even that Umamusume cannot make miracles happen alone.
Only with those who prepare and support alongside her.
And that is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A circle in the Umamusume world.
This victory was something everyone came together to achieve.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ikuno~~~.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Turbo, you don't have to force yourself to get up...
The race is already over.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "A run with everything she had... I'm sure Teio was deeply moved by it as well."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah…… Ehehehe……

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
This is our victory.
And for today—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It is my complete defeat.
Let's pick ourselves up and give it our all again tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, the news came that Tokai Teio
would continue her racing career.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo rejoiced and screamed with all her might,
and then—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Zzz... fshuuuu...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Burned out.
Having exerted all my strength in the race,
I don't have a shred of energy left."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Fugoooooooh~.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Zzzzzz...! Hnnngh, snrrk...! Grrrrh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...All that came back were sleep-talking murmurs. In a way,
maybe Twin Turbo had already done everything she needed to do this year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If that is the case...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A miraculous comeback. Believing
that there was just barely enough time before year's end.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Mnh-mnh-mnh... Tei... o♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Twin Turbo fast asleep,
I filled out the race entry form beside her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her next race—the Arima Kinen.
